description: Cost of legalising a car that is ALREADY in Portugal (registered in another EU country, brought in by the owner) through TransparentCars: a fixed service fee + ISV + state fees (inspection, IMT, registration, DUA, plates) + the COC if it is missing, returned as a low/high range. Only the service fee is TransparentCars' price; ISV, state fees and the COC are paid separately at real cost against official receipts. Also returns exactly what the fee includes and what it doesn't. Use this when the user already has the car; for buying and importing a car use calculate_import_cost.

cc.description: Engine displacement in cm³ (0 for electric)

fuel.description: petrol, diesel, hybrid, hybrid_diesel, phev, electric, lpg

has_coc.description: Does the car have its COC (certificate of conformity)? Default true; false adds the COC cost range

name: calculate_legalization_cost
